items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, do you ever hear your music as a question of singing, Thornburn?

ctx.x: The experience, direct, from the, you know, listening and making his own chords. Good chords, but he used them to his own instincts, you see.
Well, do you ever hear your music as a question of singing, Thornburn? Yeah. Yeah.

That's, uh, you may call it a straight drum, or play leads, or vibration. Yeah. Lift drills, and lift things like that. That's my idea about singing. Yeah. And playing, I guess. Mostly the lead, and, yeah, kind of melody. Yes, that's right. Not too much fapping, you know, like we used to do.
